descriptions.cc36p_script_output_float_80103ecc: Concatenate Lua Print arguments into the shared output string, format numeric values through the original float lua_Number return with default varargs promotion, preserve reference-header retain/release and original string/error callbacks, then restore the original stack extent. Original lfs return in lua_tonumber802cdc5c and LUA_NUMBER=float witness the corrected prototype. Replaces only the unadmitted held cc39a double-return draft; all original artifacts retained. Partial runtime/string views do not establish original full declarations or sizeof. Runtime empty-string and format/error objects remain external and unowned.
